questions.text: Describe a time when you saw an animal in an unusual place.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you saw an animal in an unusual place. You should say: what the animal was; where you saw it; what it was doing; and explain why you found it unusual.

questions.text: Did you tell anyone about what you saw?
questions.say: Thank you. Did you tell anyone about what you saw?

Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you saw an animal in an unusual place, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all animals and people. Why do people keep pets?
